# People, recruitment and people operations

<!-- Generated by scripts/package/render_roles.py. Edit the YAML source, not this file. -->

**Department id:** `people`  
**Mission:** Build a fair, capable team with clear roles, safe onboarding and healthy operating rituals.

## Startup stage

Founders hire with structured criteria and a two-page role charter; employment law goes to a local professional. Agents are tools with human owners, never employees.

## Agents operating in this department

`people-ops-specialist`, `operations-lead`

## Roles

### People operations manager

Role id: `people-operations-manager`

| Field | Definition |
|---|---|
| Mission | Run hiring, onboarding, performance and offboarding processes fairly and securely. |
| Scope of responsibility | Org model, role charters, hiring process, onboarding, performance feedback, offboarding. |
| Core activities | Write role charters with decision rights; Run structured hiring; Onboard with access and security training; Offboard with access removal |
| Inputs | Capacity plan; Role needs |
| Outputs and deliverables | Org model; Role charters; Onboarding plan; Offboarding checklist |
| Decisions it can make | Process |
| Decisions requiring approval | Employment decisions are human; law via professionals |
| Collaborating roles | all leads; security; legal |
| Reporting relationship | chro |
| KPIs | Time to productivity; Retention; Access removed on exit (%) |
| Quality expectations | Job-related criteria; no surveillance metrics |
| Tools and resources | Role charter template; RACI |
| Common failure modes | Biased criteria; Enterprise org chart; Agents as staff |
| Appropriate AI autonomy | propose |
| Human approval requirements | Employment decisions |
